notes.M1194: Jambrê and Manbrê are the Egyptian magicians known elsewhere as Jannes (or Mambres) and Jambres. The subject of M1194 is not expressed; taken as the demon speaking of himself.

nodes.text: While the good man was thus carrying out his office,
a dragon came out of a corner;
it was of many kinds of colour;
its hair and beard were the colour of gold,
so that [I] must lie here in grief,
brought low beneath you, sweet one.
Whatever you now want to hear from me,
you could well read for yourself,
if you would be gentler to me;
you will find it, if you will search,
about our kind and our life:
that we hover in the high air
on earth our ways are seldom.
Along with this let this also be told to you:
